title: Transition W10: context-packet intervention through the provider-neutral adapter seam (Phase 3)
description:
Workstream W10 of the integrated ADR 0020 transition design, Phase 3 (section
12.3), with the packet contract in section 7:
docs/audits/rules-awareness-transition/2026-07-30-integrated-transition-design.md.
That design is the accepted deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed
head afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). ADR 0020 controls.

OWNER
This bead is the single owner of context-packet intervention: the first change to
what the DM actually receives. No other bead owns it.

SCOPE
Inject the discovery context packet in scripted, provider-neutral tests and
compare against the recorded shadow baseline. Provider-neutral means through the
existing adapter seam (ADR 0010), not through one provider's agent loop.

The packet carries, per retained candidate (design section 7.1): canonical record
identity; source provenance and licence identity; the exact source prose the
fixture requires; every retrieval reason; traversed relationships; known source
ambiguity with its interpretations; the applicable campaign rule or ruling from
eshyra-jhpt with identity, scope, provenance, and supersession status;
deterministic capability availability with inputs, exclusions, revision, and
residual DM interpretation; and explicit projection-limit notes.

Observe: whether must-include material reaches the DM; whether routes survive
dedup; whether mandatory candidates survive budgets; whether source prose stays
intact; whether partial-projection limits are explicit; whether campaign rules
and rulings carry correct scope and provenance; whether capability limits are
shown correctly; auditor retries; explicit citations or tool calls; accepted
deterministic state effects. Report M1-M12 against the recorded baseline.

PROHIBITIONS (design sections 7.2, 7.3, 13.2)
- A typed projection is never presented as complete merely because it exists,
  and never converts into deterministic readiness. Source prose stays verbatim
  and authoritative; the projection's omissions are disclosed in band beside it
  (the verified worked cases are creature:adult-black-dragon /data/actions/5 and
  spell:fireball's missing typed area).
- A must-consider candidate never disappears silently. Overflow is explicit,
  names every dropped candidate and its routes, and fails the probe.
- A record whose provenance is known false is never laundered into the packet as
  authority (probe P12).
- "No capability bound" is never presented as "no mechanics", "irrelevant", or
  "safe to ignore"; capability availability is a positive bounded contract with
  declared exclusions, joined at packet-build time, never inferred from typed
  fields.
- Packet presence is never reported as proof the model used the material. No
  trustworthy used-versus-ignored signal exists; citations and tool-call
  correlation are suggestive, never proof.
- No campaign-rule or ruling schema, store, resolver, supersession lifecycle, or
  house-rule subsystem is defined here; those stay with eshyra-jhpt. Campaign
  material reaches the packet only through W11.
- No universal discovery-completeness claim, no corpus-wide capability
  inventory, and no aggregate readiness or coverage score.

DEPENDENCIES
W9 (shadow evidence and the recorded baseline) and W11 (the jhpt rule/ruling
fields). Not parallel-safe with either.

PERMANENT EVIDENCE
Scripted provider-neutral intervention tests through the ADR 0010 adapter seam,
reporting M1-M12 against the recorded baseline, including every must-consider
overflow occurrence and the probe it failed.

REQUIRED NEXT STATE
Scripted provider-neutral intervention runs produce M1-M12 against a recorded
baseline; no must-consider overflow occurred, or every occurrence failed its
probe as designed.

MATERIAL CHANGE: yes. This changes what the DM receives.
acceptance_criteria:
Packet intervention is exercised by scripted, provider-neutral tests through the
existing ADR 0010 adapter seam, never through one provider's agent loop. Source
prose reaches the DM verbatim and remains the authoritative content; a typed
projection never replaces, suppresses, or overwrites it. Every partial
projection discloses its limits in band beside the projection, with the verified
creature:adult-black-dragon success-branch omission and the spell:fireball
missing typed area proven as cases; projection presence never converts into
deterministic readiness. Must-consider candidates never disappear silently:
every budget-driven drop emits an explicit overflow record naming the candidate
and its routes and fails the probe, and related/exploratory drops each record a
reason. Campaign rules and rulings appear with identity, kind, campaign scope,
provenance, effective position, and supersession status, obtained through W11
from the eshyra-jhpt runtime, and the governing source material remains present
and attributed beside them. Capability availability is a positive bounded
contract stating operation, required inputs, exclusions, revision/identity, and
residual DM interpretation, joined at packet-build time and never inferred from
typed-field presence; absence of a binding is presented as "no capability
positively selected", never as "no mechanics" or "safe to ignore". A record with
known-false provenance is never surfaced as authority. M1-M12 are reported per
probe against the recorded shadow baseline, kept independent, and never
collapsed into a coverage, readiness, or completeness score. No report claims
that the model used the packet's material because it was present.

TRACEABILITY: every bead in the W7-W15 set was created 2026-07-31 to execute the
design accepted as the deliverable of eshyra-o9bd.19.8 (PR #485, reviewed head
afd113c7090378c3a9f4122f246a6c32602a5164, merge commit
042ce119aa699f04f60a1885d471335f07745282). They are parented to the ACTIVE
transition epic (eshyra-o9bd.19, or eshyra-olc5 for W13) rather than to the
closed design bead, so lifecycle semantics stay honest; eshyra-o9bd.19.8 remains
the design authority and is referenced from each description.

BOUNDARY THAT MUST NOT ERODE (design sections 8.4 and 14.3): campaign-rule
persistence and ruling lifecycle do not move out of eshyra-jhpt under any of
these items. W11 consumes; it does not own. If the jhpt interface proves
insufficient, the correct response is an amendment or a child under eshyra-jhpt,
never a discovery-local store.
